name: sdd
description: Implement a superpowers plan or an OpenSpec change through subagents: /sdd:apply drives one unit controller per unit, with implementers and reviewers one layer down, and archives the run.

questionBudget.title: Question budget
questionBudget.description: How many refused questions in a row noask allows before its question budget is spent: a whole number from 1 to 99999; any other value counts as 6.

denialBudget.title: Denial budget
denialBudget.description: How many denials, the fence's included, in a row noask allows before its denial budget is spent: a whole number from 1 to 99999; any other value counts as 10.

continuationBudget.title: Continuation budget
continuationBudget.description: How many turns in a row noask continues without an end-of-turn line before its continuation budget is spent: a whole number from 1 to 99999; any other value counts as 20.

fence.title: Fence
fence.description: While noask is on, deny each outward call the plugin names exactly, such as a push, before it runs, and count it as a denial; off leaves those calls to the rule text.

permissionHook.title: Permission hook
permissionHook.description: While noask is on, deny a permission prompt and decline a tool server's question in the owner's place, and count each as a denial; off lets them wait for the owner.

terminal.title: Terminal command
terminal.description: link: at session start, keep a noask command in ~/.local/bin that runs this plugin; off: remove the link this plugin made and add none.
